crossRefs.note: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is…
who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
“For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
“For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all…

translations.web: Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
translations.bsb: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, or informed Him as His counselor?
translations.kjv: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught
translations.asv: Who hath directed the Spirit of Jehovah, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
